title: Signal Defaults
description: Dataset-level signal properties that are shared across all (or most) recordings. Following the BIDS inheritance principle, these values apply to all data files unless overridden at the record level.

sampling_frequency.description: Default sampling frequency in Hz (applies to all recordings unless overridden per-file).

power_line_frequency.description: Power line frequency in Hz (typically 50 or 60).

placement_scheme.description: Detailed electrode placement scheme from BIDS EEG sidecar (e.g., 'extended 10-10% system').
